I have $1295 and am on CONNECTICUT_AVENUE. Most of my properties are mortgaged. I own reds with four houses each and two mortgaged railroads.

The opponent cannot skip the reds entirely. Those properties occupy four consecutive spaces, so they must land on at least one of them before passing GO.

Building more than hotels is impossible, so the hotel strategy remains correct.

I considered unmortgaging cheap properties to drain the opponent before they reach the reds, but every space on their path from Oriental Avenue is mortgaged. Hotels remain the only viable strategy.

I also rejected draining cash by unmortgaging properties they will land on, since the interest and reduced cash cushion outweigh any benefit. I briefly considered unmortgaging the B&O Railroad, but that would cost $110 and only yield $25 in rent, which is not worth it.
